ai_usage_events_amount_read_ck.name: ai_usage_events_amount_read_ck
ai_usage_events_amount_read_ck.value: "ai_usage_events"."feature" <> 'amount_read' OR ("ai_usage_events"."document_source" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_usage_events"."document_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_usage_events"."outcome" IN ('found', 'none', 'failed'))

ai_usage_events_monthly_summary_ck.name: ai_usage_events_monthly_summary_ck
ai_usage_events_monthly_summary_ck.value: "ai_usage_events"."feature" <> 'monthly_summary' OR ("ai_usage_events"."funding_source_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_usage_events"."month" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_usage_events"."trigger" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_usage_events"."outcome" IN ('success', 'rejected', 'failed'))

expenses_no_receipt_reason_ck.name: expenses_no_receipt_reason_ck
expenses_no_receipt_reason_ck.value: not "expenses"."no_receipt" or ("expenses"."no_receipt_reason" is not null and btrim("expenses"."no_receipt_reason") <> '')

shared_links_revoked_by_ck.name: shared_links_revoked_by_ck
shared_links_revoked_by_ck.value: "shared_links"."revoked_by" is null or "shared_links"."revoked_at" is not null
